question: Can the WSP137 source-blind 17,640-template active action policy be made materially faster while exactly preserving all intervention choices, learned relationships, confident errors, abstentions and cold retention? Test on new synthetic causal worlds with *one* shared source outcome per matched action, not an overlapping old first-use cohort.

algorithm.original: Load source-free WSP137 ActivePolicy and DirectArm at pinned parent SHA, no changes. Exactly first 4 original fixed x, next 28 from sorted first256 survivors' (min(vote0,vote1),unseen,-x) score; after32 observations original WSP135 final 17,640-template fit, top64, 80% participation,90% agree.
algorithm.candidate: New LazyActivePolicy lazily checks consistency of candidate i's 16-entry output table against each newly observed actual public consequence only when that candidate could enter the first 256 surviving hypotheses. Cache per-candidate seen/ones 16bit bitsets, processed_obs count and permanence of rejection, without changing WSP137's exact SHA-ranked hypothesis order or action-choice tie breaks. First4, fallback, final WSP135 numeric fit/readout, all confidence decisions UNCHANGED.
algorithm.fidelity: Independent original WSP137 arm and fast arm each independently choose x from exactly same public previous x/effect transcript. Require same x before effect. One source custodian queried ONCE per x, single signed receipt supplied to both. Fail and charge no additional action if chooser disagreement. Compare both full 64-surface predicted answers per world, not just held. Require byte-identical snapshot states, canonical learner effect receipts, and exactly same cold-restored outputs.
algorithm.reference: Same-information independent WSP135 symbolic codebook control receives 32 shared effects per world, exact prediction parity with both numerical arms. Source-grammar oracle from WSP136 used only as separate evaluator reference with explicit privileged prior, not to guide actions.

source.forbidden: all other source seeds (202800..202863, 203800..203863, 204800..204863, 205800..205863), all prior WSP137 198xxx/199xxx/201xxx and actual original DTR/CausalGym cohorts
source.source_generators: Exact code shape of earlier WSP137 source, SHA256 WSP138|KNOWN|seed or WSP138|UNFAMILIAR|seed or WSP138|OFF|seed; source-only shuffled six role inputs and 4-gate pair compositions; unknown uses majority(g1,g2,p4) XOR p5, off uses preexisting cross-interaction negative. No source truth or seed to chooser, equal 32 actual paid actions/world; 32 held each.
source.public_action: 64 typed x inputs and opaque ID mapping public before probe; training pool exact WSP137 available_pool() 48, common held x16 never queried; public query-location information, not query-blind generalization.
source.firstuse_authority: public deterministic source-safe engineering only; denied original DTR/MDP protected original/virgin source.

controls.held_surface: score common16, arm-unique held16, full64 output parity, no feedback after scoring
controls.distinct_arms: WSP137 ORIGINAL + WSP138 LAZY, identical source data; independent symbolic and fully trained original conventional CART reference on exactly same effects, no-update
controls.cold: old-law prediction preservation after later worlds, byte-identical baseline/optimized cold snapshots and predictions, 6 source-free relabeled known laws 384/384 identical prior readouts, 0 source effects
controls.numeric_baseline: Original WSP135 fit/predict is unchanged shared across both arms; no other representation improvements allowed.

measurement.profiling: Warm immutable candidate bank and codebooks before per-arm time measurement. Alternate whether original or lazy chooses/observes first each world to mitigate ordering; use separate monotonic wall and process_cpu counters around original and optimized choose+observe, and both full fit+full64 readout+snapshot phases. Preserve per-world timings in committed original result with platform details; include peak tracemalloc and structural allocations. No paid energy API.
acceptance_frozen: original action choice equals fast choice at every one of 1024 paid actions; all final 64 predictions per world identical; same source receipts and learned-state snapshots/cold readouts; no source first-use breach
at least 2.0x aggregate original-to-lazy choose+observe CPU-time ratio on EACH of Ubuntu and Windows, with at least 2.0x wall-time ratio per platform

at least 1.25x aggregate original-to-lazy source-free model computation full phase (choose/observe + original unchanged fit/readout/snapshot), on EACH OS, with no increase in source calls or outcome error/abstention
optimized per-model persistent learning state at most 25% of original total per-template extra mutable storage, measured by structure counts or sys.getsizeof with assumptions disclosed
same-information symbolic prediction parity, no old-world interference, cold restore and source-protection negative checks PASS
measurement.failure_policy: If any predeclared condition fails classify DEVELOPMENT_COST_OPTIMIZATION_NO_GO even if engineering tests pass. Preserve both speed and negative; no threshold changes post-outcome. Engineering PASS only after two-platform full exact candidate CI and G29.

governance.authority: isolated public source-safe draft research only; user standing scientific implementation does not grant merge/native admission/first-use
